article_title: Biohythane production via anaerobic digestion process: fundamentals, scale-up challenges, and techno-economic and environmental aspects
notes: LBR advantages: suitable for high TS feedstocks, low energy/water demand, effective separation of dissolved organics, prevents loss of partially decomposed substrate; disadvantages: inefficient hydrolysis of complex feedstocks, operational complexity, risk of bed clogging at high OLRs.
